outcome: childhood embryonal solid tumors (central nervous system and non-central nervous system)
finding: Male gender, high maternal education level, and birth anomalies are risk factors for childhood embryonal solid tumors, while cesarean section, birth order, and 5-minute Apgar score show associations with specific tumor subtypes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was a significant risk factor for childhood embryonal solid tumors among children diagnosed older than 24 months of age.
